n-k-l1f-03.title: Seddex liin yaanyo, heshiis fiican?
n-k-l1f-03.goal: Tijaabi sheegasho iibsade oo ka soo hor jeedda calaamad qiime, kala saar qiimaha shay kasta iyo wadarka, oo lambarro ku sii talo.
n-k-l1f-03.material:
Meel bannaan oo ay liinta ka iibiyaan, Jisu iyo saaxiibkeed Minsu waxay akhriyaan calaamadda:

[귤]
한 개: 1,000원
세 개: 2,500원

Jisu: 저는 귤 두 개만 필요해요.
Minsu: 세 개에 이천오백 원이에요! 싸요! 세 개 사요!
n-k-l1f-03.thinking.1: Qiimaha shay kasta iyo qiimaha wadarka
n-k-l1f-03.thinking.2: U habaynta talo baahida dhabta ah ee qofka
n-k-l1f-03.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan 개 iyo tirooyinka Sino-Kuuriya ee qiimayaasha
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.prompt: Akhri calaamadda. Weedhee ayay calaamaddu taageertaa?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.hint.0: Isbarbar dhig qiimaha saddex liin oo gooni ah iyo qiimaha xirmada saddexda.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.hint.1: Dabadeed isbarbar dhig wadarrada tiro isku mid ah oo liimo ah.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.a: Saddex liin waxay ku kacaan wax ka yar laba liin.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.r.a: 3 liin waxay ku kacaan 2,500 won; 2 liin waxay ku kacaan 2,000 won.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.b: Laba liin oo qiimaha gooni ah waxay ku kacaan wax ka badan xirmada saddexda.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.r.b: 2 x 1,000 = 2,000 won, taas oo ka yar 2,500 won.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.c: Liin kasta oo xirmada saddexda ku jirta waxay ku kacdaa wax ka yar hal liin oo gooni ah.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.o.d: Xirmada saddexdu waxay ku kacdaa isku mid saddex liin oo gooni ah.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.r.d: 3 gooni ah waxay ku kacaan 3,000 won, ma aha 2,500 won.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s1.explain: Xirmadu waxay ku kacdaa 2,500 won saddexda, qiyaastii 833 won mid kasta, hal gooni ahna waa 1,000 won. Sidaa darteed liin kasta xirmada waa ka jaban tahay, laakiin xirmadu wadar ahaan waxay ku kacdaa wax ka badan laba gooni ah.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.prompt: Jisu waxay u baahan tahay laba liin oo keliya berri. Miyuu talada Minsu '세 개 사요, 싸요!' u fiican tahay jeebkeeda?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qor imisa liin ayay Jisu u baahan tahay, dabadeed xisaabi kharashka tiradaas saxda ah si kasta.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.hint.1: Weydii in 'jaban' weedha Minsu ay ka dhigan tahay liin kasta mise wadar ahaan.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.a: Haa. Liin kasta xirmada waa ka jaban tahay, sidaa darteed xirmadu way u jabantahay.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.r.a: Jaban liin kasta macnaheedu ma aha jaban wadar ahaan. Waxay bixin lahayd 2,500 won, ma aha 2,000 won.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.b: Maya. Laba gooni ah waxay ku kacaan 2,000 won, xirmaduna waxay ku kacdaa wax ka badan.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.c: Haa. 2,500 won waa ka yar 3,000 won.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.r.c: 3,000 won waa qiimaha saddex gooni ah, laakiin waxay u baahan tahay laba liin oo keliya.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.o.d: Lagu go'aamin karo ma aha maxaa yeelay calaamaddu qiime laba liin ah ma laha.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.r.d: Laba gooni ah waxay ku kacaan 2 x 1,000 = 2,000 won; calaamaddu waxay bixisaa wax ku filan.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s2.explain: Laba liin, laba gooni ah (2,000 won) waa ka jaban yihiin xirmada (2,500 won). Sheegashada Minsu waa run liin kasta, laakiin ma aha wixii Jisu u baahan tahay.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.prompt: Qor 1-2 weedh oo talo ah oo Jisu loogu talagalay (Ingiriis ama Kuuriyaan). Isticmaal lambarrada calaamadda sida caddayn.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.hint.0: Sheeg wixii Jisu u baahan tahay, dabadeed sii wadarka habka iibsiga kasta.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ku soo gabagabee habka ugu jaban ee iyada ku habboon.
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Miyaan bixiyay laba lambar, ma aha 'waa jaban yahay' oo keliya?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Miyuu talaydu ku habboon yahay in Jisu u baahan tahay laba liin?
n-k-l1f-03.s.s3.model.1: Laba liin, iibso laba gooni ah: 2,000 won. Xirmada saddexdu waa 2,500 won, sidaa darteed waxay ku kacdaa wax ka badan inkastoo liin kasta ka jaban tahay.

n-k-l1e-01.title: Magac, shaqo ... iyo dal?
n-k-l1e-01.goal: Ogow in laba kaarar is-barasho aysan ka koobnayn xaqiiqada su'aashu weydiisato, go'aami waxa weli maqan, oo ku weydii Kuuriyaan.
n-k-l1e-01.material:
Maalinta koowaad ee fasalka. Macallinkaagu wuxuu qaybiyaa laba kaarar is-barasho (loo sameeyay shaqadan).

[카드 1]
안녕하세요? 저는 수진이에요. 학생이에요.

[카드 2]
안녕하세요? 저는 마이클이에요. 선생님이에요.

Macallinku wuxuu tilmaamayaa kaarka 1 wuxuuna weydiiyaa: "수진 씨는 한국 사람이에요?"
n-k-l1e-01.thinking.1: Magac waa tilmaan, ma aha caddayn
n-k-l1e-01.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan 이름, 학생, 선생님, 사람 iyo magacyada dalalka
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.prompt: Macallinkaagu wuxuu weydiiyaa: '수진 씨는 한국 사람이에요?' Adigoo isticmaalaya labada kaarar oo keliya, jawaabtee ayaa ugu fiican?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ku taxay waxa sadar kasta oo kaarka 1 ah kuu sheegayo: magac, shaqo ... wax kale?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.hint.1: Isweydii haddii kaararku ka kooban yihiin eray dal ama '-사람'.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.a: Haa. 수진 waa magac Kuuriyaan, sidaa darteed waxay ka timid Kuuriya.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.r.a: Magac waa tilmaan, ma aha caddayn: dad dalal badan ayaa leh magacyo Kuuriyaan, dadka Kuuriyaanka ahna waxay leeyihiin magacyo kale. Raadi weedh magacaabaysa dal.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.b: Maya. 학생 macnaheedu waa waxay dibadda wax ku barataa, sidaa darteed ma aha Kuuriyaan.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.r.b: 학생 macnaheedu waa 'arday' oo keliya. Waxba kama sheego halka ay ka timid.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.c: Weli maya. Kaararku waxay bixiyaan magaceeda iyo shaqadeeda, laakiin dal ma bixiyaan.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.o.d: Weli maya. Kaarka 1 magac ma leh, sidaa darteed cidna ma sheegi karto.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.r.d: Magacu wuxuu ku yaal kaarka: 수진. Qaybta maqan waa mid kale.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s1.explain: Kaarka 1 wuxuu bixiyaa magac (수진) iyo shaqo (학생) laakiin weligeed ma bixiyo dal. Kaarka 2 ma caawiyo: wuxuu ku saabsan yahay 마이클. Jawaabtu waa 'weli lama yaqaan' oo waxaad u baahan tahay hal xaqiiqo oo dheeraad ah.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.prompt: Ka fikir 수진 inay ku darto HAL weedh kaarkeeda. Weedhaha lagu daray ee kee ayaa xalin lahaa su'aasha macallinka? Dooro dhammaan kuwa xalin lahaa ('haa' ama 'maya' labaduba way tirsan yihiin).
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.hint.0: Raadi weedhaha magacaabaya dalka qof, ma aha hiwaayad ama daraasad.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.hint.1: Weedh kasta tijaabi: kadib akhrintiisa, ma dhihi kartaa 'haa' ama 'maya' si hubaal ah?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.r.a: Dad badan oo dalal badan ka yimid ayaa baranaya Kuuriyaan, sidaa darteed tani ma sheegto dalkeeda.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.r.d: Jacaylka kafeega waxba ku saabsan dal ma aha.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s2.explain: Weedh leh '-사람이에요' waxay magacaabaysaa dalka. 호주 사람 wuxuu ku jawaabayaa 'maya', 한국 사람 wuxuu ku jawaabayaa 'haa'. Barashada Kuuriyaan ama jacaylka kafeega ma go'aamiyo.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.prompt: Qor su'aashaada 수진 Kuuriyaan (hadal edeb leh -요) si aad u ogaato xaqiiqada maqan.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore go'aami xaqiiqada maqan, kadibna taas oo keliya weydii.
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma su'aashaydu waxay weydiisaa xaqiiqada maqan (dalka) ma aha wax kaararku horeyba sheegeen?
n-k-l1e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma edeb (-요) baa oo ma ku filan gaaban tahay in hal weedh lagu jawaabo?

n-k-l1e-02.title: Calaamadda Rina iyo erayada Rina
n-k-l1e-02.goal: Ku hubi is-barasho hadal ah calaamad magac, hel hal sadar oo xaqiiqadiisu khaldan tahay, magacow nooca khaladka, oo saxo.
n-k-l1e-02.material:
Rina waa marti. Waxay xidhaa calaamad magac waxayna isu barataa fasalka.

[이름표]
이름: 리나
나라: 일본
직업: 선생님

Waxay dhahdaa shanta sadar ee hoose.
n-k-l1e-02.thinking.0: Hubinta qoraal iyadoo isha lala barbar dhigayo
n-k-l1e-02.thinking.1: Kala saaridda khalad naxwe iyo xaqiiqo khaldan
n-k-l1e-02.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan 선생님, 학생, 일본 사람 iyo -이에요/예요
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.prompt: Rina waxay is-barashadeeda codka kor ugu akhrinaysaa. La barbar dhig calaamadeeda magac. Hal sadar oo keliya ayaan la jaan qaadin calaamadda. Sadarkee?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sadarro qaarkood waa salaano oo xaqiiqooyin ma sido. Calaamadee sadarrada sida xaqiiqooyin.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.hint.1: Calaamadda xaqiiqo-xaqiiqo u qaado (magac, dal, shaqo) oo hel sadarka mid kasta sheegaya.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 4 wuxuu leeyahay 학생이에요 ('Waxaan ahay arday'), laakiin calaamaddu waxay leedahay 선생님 (macallin). Kuuriyaanka sadarka 4 naxwe ahaan waa fiican yahay; xaqiiqadu waa khalad. Sadarrada 2 iyo 3 waxay waafaqsan yihiin calaamadda, sadarrada 1 iyo 5 na waa salaano xaqiiqooyin ma sido.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.prompt: Sadarka aad dooratay noocee khalad ah?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sadarka codka kor u akhri sida naxwaha oo keliya: ma jebiyaa xeer?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kadibna macnihiisa, ma aha qaabkiisa, la barbar dhig calaamadda.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.o.a: Dhammaad khaldan: waa inuu ahaadaa -예요, ma aha -이에요.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.r.a: Dhammaadka -이에요 waa sax kadib higgaad leh shibbane dhammaad (생). Weedhu waa naxwe sax.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.o.b: Naxwuhu wuu fiican yahay, laakiin xaqiiqadu waxay ka duwan tahay calaamadda magac.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.o.c: Aad u caadi ah kulan koowaad.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.r.c: Dhammaadka -요 horeyba waa edeb, sidaa darteed heerka hadalku waa fiican yahay.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.r.d: 저는 waa erayga edebta ee 'aniga' wuxuuna ku habboon yahay kulan koowaad; 나는 wuxuu ahaan lahaa mid caadi ah.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s2.explain: Sadar wuxuu noqon karaa Kuuriyaan sax ah weli na khalad u ah xaaladda. Halkan weedhu waa fiican tahay, laakiin ma waafaqsana calaamadda.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.prompt: Dib u qor sadarka khaldan Kuuriyaan si uu ula jaan qaado calaamadda magac. Ilaali hadal edeb leh -요.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.hint.0: Erayga shaqada ee saxda ah ee calaamadda ku dhig isla qaabka weedha.
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.hint.1: Hubi dhammaadka: erayga shaqada ma ku dhammaadaa shibbane mise shaqal?
n-k-l1e-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sadarkaygu wuxuu sheegayaa shaqada calaamadda ku taal?

n-k-l1e-03.title: Hal eray, saddex muuqaal
n-k-l1e-03.goal: Akhri isla eray Kuuriyaan ah saddex muuqaal oo kordhaya, dib u eeg macnaha marka xaaladdu isbeddesho, dheh waxa go'aamiyey, oo adigu si sax ah u isticmaal.
n-k-l1e-03.material: Saddex muuqaal oo gaaban oo u dhexeeya saaxiibada fasalka 하나 iyo 민수 (la sameeyey). Waxay isticmaalaan hadal edeb leh -요. Muuqaal kasta waxaa la muujiyaa mid mid.
n-k-l1e-03.thinking.0: Macnuhu wuxuu ku xiran yahay macnaha guud
n-k-l1e-03.thinking.1: Dib u eegidda tarjumaad macluumaad cusub
n-k-l1e-03.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan 고마워요, 죄송해요 iyo 선생님
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.prompt: Isla erayga wuxuu ka muuqdaa saddex muuqaal yaryar. Akhri muuqaal kasta oo go'aami macnaha halkaas ka hor intaadan arkin kan xiga.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ka hor intaadan dooran, akhri sadarka ka hor erayga.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.hint.1: Weydii maxay qofka kale hadda sameeyeen: weydiiyeen, mahadiyeen ama cafiseen?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.info:
Muuqaalka 1. 하나 waxay u soo bandhigaysaa saaxiibkeed 민수.

하나: 민수 씨, 이 사람은 지우 씨예요.
민수: 지우 씨는 선생님이에요?
하나: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Maxay 아니에요 ee 하나 macnaheedu yahay halkan?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Marka la jawaabayo su'aal yes/no, 아니에요 macnaheedu waa 'maya'.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Cidina iyada ma mahadin, sidaas darteed 'ma jiro dhib' sabab uma leh in la yidhaahdo.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Cidina wax khalad ah ma samayn muuqaalkan.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Waxba looma baahna in la cafiyo halkan; 민수 wuxuu weydiiyey su'aal.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.info:
Muuqaalka 2. Kadib, 민수 wuxuu 하나 amaajiyey qalin.

하나: 고마워요!
민수: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Maxay 아니에요 ee 민수 macnaheedu yahay hadda?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Kadib 고마워요, 아니에요 waa jawaab dabeecad leh: 'Waa waxba.' Isla erayga hadda wuxuu jawaabaa mahadnaq, ma aha su'aal.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wuxuu u dhiibayaa qalinka. Tani waxay akhrisaa erayga sida muuqaalka 1 waxayna iska indho tirtaa waxa 하나 hadda yidhi.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Cidna ma weydiin yaa uu yahay.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wax uu cafis ka weydiisto ma jiraan.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.info:
Muuqaalka 3. Marinka, 민수 wuxuu ku dhacay gacanta 하나.

민수: 죄송해요!
하나: 아니에요.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Kadib cafis, 아니에요 macnaheedu waa 'Waa fiican yahay, ha welwelin.' Hal eray, saddex shaqo: sadarka ka horreeya ayaa go'aamiya.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Muuqaalka waxba kuma jiraan sheegaya iyadu inay shaki ku qabto; kadib cafis, erayga wuxuu bixiyaa raaxo.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Cidna ma weydiin yaa ay tahay.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s1.reflect: Ma akhrintaadii 아니에요 ayay isbeddeshay muuqaal ilaa muuqaal? Maxaad eegtay si aad u go'aamiso mar kasta?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.prompt: Dib u eegidda saddexda muuqaal, maxaa go'aamiyey macnaha 아니에요 mar kasta?
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.hint.0: Is barbar dhig waxa ahaa isku mid iyo waxa isbeddelay saddexda muuqaal dhexdooda.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.hint.1: Eeg wixii ka horreeyay erayga isla markiiba mar kasta.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.a: Erayga wuxuu ahaa isku mid mar kasta, sidaas darteed ma noqon karo waxa beddelay macnaha.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.o.b: Sadarka isla markiiba la yidhi ka hor, iyo waxa hadda dhacay.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.o.c: Inuu hadlaha ahaa nin ama naag.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.c: Labada nin iyo naag labaduba waxay erayga u isticmaalaan saddexdaas hab.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.o.d: Sida cod dheer loo yidhi erayga.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.r.d: Howshani waxay ku saabsan tahay qoraal qoran; macnuhu halkan wuxuu ka yimaadaa erayada hore.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s2.explain: Erayga weligiis ma is beddelin. Macnuhu wuxuu ka yimid sadarka hore: su'aal (maya), mahadnaq (waa waxba) ama cafis (waa fiican yahay).
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.prompt: Saaxiib fasal ayaa ku yidhi '고마워요!' sababtoo ah waad amaajisay qalin. Ku jawaab Kuuriyaan (hadal edeb leh -요) adigoo odhanaya 'Waa waxba' si dabeecad leh.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ka fikir sadarka aad aragtay kadib 고마워요 muuqaalka 2.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ilaali dhammaadka edebta leh (-요); jawaab gaaban waa fiican tahay.
n-k-l1e-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma jawaabtaydu waxay yarayn faa'iidada halkii ay celin lahayd mahadnaqa?

n-k-l1e-04.title: Yaa ka yar? Is barbar dhig oo keliya
n-k-l1e-04.goal: U beddel afar is-barbar dhig caadi ah oo da'da oo keliya is barbar dhiga qaanuun, dhis dhawr koox da' oo sax ah, salaan si edeb leh adigoo isticmaalaya mid, oo hel waxa dhammaantood run ku ah.
n-k-l1e-04.material:
Afar qof ayaa kulmay fasalka Kuuriyaanka (dhammaantood la sameeyey). 민아 wuxuu sheegaa da'diisa. Kuwa kale waxay is barbar dhigaan oo keliya.

민아: 저는 20살이에요.
하나: 저는 민아 씨보다 어려요. 지호 씨보다 나이가 많아요.
선생님: 저는 민아 씨보다 나이가 많아요.
(지호 da'da waxba ma sheego.)

Erayada: 어려요 = yar (ka yar); 나이가 많아요 = ka weyn; A보다 = ka A.
n-k-l1e-04.thinking.0: Is barbar dhigyadu ma aha tirooyin
n-k-l1e-04.thinking.2: Waxa ku run ah kiis kasta
n-k-l1e-04.prereq.2: Wuxuu la kulmay -보다 (ka); waxaa lagu sharaxay agabka hoostiisa
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.prompt: Hana wuxuu leeyahay: '저는 민아 씨보다 어려요.' Maxay kuu sheegtaa ku saabsan Hana?
n-k-l1e-04.s.s1.hint.0: Hel 보다 weedha dhexdeeda oo arag labada qof ee uu isku xirayo.

n-k-l1f-02.goal: Fariin gaaban u beddel shuruudo sax ah, hel dalabyo dhowr ah oo dhammaan shuruudaha buuxiya, oo mid ka sheeg Kuuriyaan.
n-k-l1f-02.material:
Saaxiibkaa ayaa fariin kuu soo diraya ka hor intaadan tegin makhaayadda kafeega:

"커피도 주스도 사 와요. 모두 다섯 잔이에요. 돈은 만 삼천 원 있어요."

Erayada: 커피도 주스도 = kafee iyo cabitaan midab labadaba (mid kasta qaar); 모두 = wadar ahaan; 돈 = lacag; 있어요 = waad haysataa.

n-k-l1f-02.s.s2.prompt: Hel 3 dalab oo kala duwan oo fariinta oo dhan la jaan qaadaya. c = koobabka kafeega, j = koobabka cabitaanka midabka.

Calaamadda hagaajinta baska ee hortiisa isbitaalka:

월~금  06:00 ~ 22:00
토  08:00 ~ 20:00
일  없어요

n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.prompt: Waa Sabti, 7:00 subaxda (아침 일곱 시). Jun wuxuu rabaa inuu raaco baska 10 isbitaalka. Maxuu sameeyaa?

n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.r.c: Sabtida bas ayaa jira laga bilaabo 08:00.
n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.o.d: Sug hal saacad, sababtoo ah basaska Sabtida waxay bilaabmaan 08:00
n-k-l1g-05.s.s2.explain: Sadarka Sabtida wuxuu leeyahay 08:00 ~ 20:00, sidaa darteed 07:00 bas weli ma jiro laakiin hal saacad kadib wuu jiri doonaa.

n-k-l1h-01.title: Sheegashada Sora ee ku saabsan subaxyada Minsu
n-k-l1h-01.goal: Hubi sheegasho gaaban oo ku saabsan nidaam usbuuceed iyadoo la barbar dhigayo qoraalka ay ka timid, hel weedha caddaynta dhabta ah, oo saxo sheegashada adigoo isticmaalaya maalmaha iyo waqtiyada iska dhigma.
n-k-l1h-01.material:
Minsu wuxuu ka qoray usbuuciisa fasalkiisa Kuuriyaan. Fasal-wadaagkiisa Sora ayaa akhriyay oo samaysay sheegasho.

민수의 일주일
월요일부터 금요일까지 학교에 가요.
그래서 아침 여섯 시에 일어나요.
토요일과 일요일에는 열 시에 일어나요.
그리고 저녁 열한 시에 자요.

소라: 민수는 매일 여섯 시에 일어나요.

n-k-l1h-01.thinking.2: Ilaalinta waqti kasta oo ku xidhan maalmaha saxda ah
n-k-l1h-01.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan maalmaha usbuuca, 시 oo leh lambarro asal ah, iyo -아요/어요
n-k-l1h-01.prereq.2: Wuxuu yaqaan 매일 (maalin kasta); waxaa lagu sharaxay tilmaamaha
n-k-l1h-01.s.s1.prompt: Ma qoraalka Minsu wuxuu taageeraa sheegashada Sora? (매일 = maalin kasta)

n-k-l1h-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma waqti kasta wuxuu ku xigaa maalmaha saxda ah (lix maalmaha dugsiga, toban dhammaadka usbuuca)?
n-k-l1h-01.s.s3.model.2: Wuxuu toosaa 6 maalmaha shaqada iyo 10 Sabtida iyo Axadda.

n-k-l1h-02.title: Maalinlaha Hana: goorma ayay dhacday?
n-k-l1h-02.goal: Hel weedhaha maalinlaha ee erayga waqtiga iyo dhammaadka falku tilmaamaan waqtiyo kala duwan, dheh waxa khaldan, oo saxo hal weedh laba siyaabood oo suurtagal ah.
n-k-l1h-02.material:
Hana waxay qortaa maalinle gaaban subaxda Arbacada. Laba weedhood oo ka mid ah waxay leeyihiin eray waqti oo aan ku habboonayn dhammaadka falka.

(Arbaco = 수요일, shalay = 어제, maanta = 오늘, berri = 내일)
n-k-l1h-02.thinking.0: Ku waafajinta erayada waqtiga iyo dhammaadyada falka (wakhtigii tegay, hadda, mustaqbal)
n-k-l1h-02.thinking.1: Sharaxidda is-waafaq la'aan, ma aha oo keliya in la arko
n-k-l1h-02.thinking.2: Saxidda weedh in ka badan hal hab
n-k-l1h-02.prereq.2: Wuxuu la kulmay -았어요/-었어요 (wakhtigii tegay) iyo -(으)ㄹ 거예요 (mustaqbal); waxaa lagu sharaxay tilmaamaha
n-k-l1h-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal sadar halka erayga waqtiga iyo dhammaadka falku tilmaamaan waqtiyo kala duwan.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sadar kasta akhri oo dheh goorta ay dhacday: kahor maanta, maanta, ama kadib maanta.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hoos u xarriiq erayga waqtiga, kadibna eeg dhammaadka falka: -았어요/-었어요 = horey ayay u dhacday, -ㄹ 거예요 = weli ma dhicin.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s1.hint.2: Isbarbar dhig labada tilmaan ee sadar kasta. Ma is raacaan?

Sadarka 4 waa fiican yahay: qorshe maanta dambe Kuuriyaanku badanaa wuxuu isticmaalaa hadda caadiga ah (-아요/어요), sadarka 6 na wuxuu mustaqbalka ugu isticmaalay ulajeeddo.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.prompt: Eeg sadarka 3: '어제 친구를 만날 거예요.' Maxay u khaldan tahay?
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.hint.0: Hubi xarafka iyo qaabka falka si gooni ah: ma fiican yihiin?
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kadibna weydii maxay 어제 kuu sheegtaa waqtiga, maxayse -ㄹ 거예요 kuu sheegtaa.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.o.a: 친구를 waa inuu ahaado 친구가, sababtoo ah saaxiibku waa kan kulmaya.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.r.a: Xarafka 를 wuxuu calaamadaa waxa la kulmay (saaxiibka). Is-waafaq la'aantu meel kale ayay ku jirtaa.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.o.b: 어제 wuxuu u baahan yahay 에, sidaa darteed waa inuu ahaado 어제에.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.r.b: Erayada sida 어제, 오늘, 내일 halkan uma baahna 에. Is-waafaq la'aantu meel kale ayay ku jirtaa.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.o.c: 어제 wuxuu tilmaamaa wakhtigii tegay, laakiin -ㄹ 거예요 wuxuu tilmaamaa mustaqbalka.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.o.d: 만날 거예요 waa qaab khalad ah, sababtoo ah 만나다 ma qaadan karo -ㄹ 거예요.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.r.d: -ㄹ 거예요 wuu raaci karaa falkan; qaabku waa fiican yahay. Is-waafaq la'aantu meel kale ayay ku jirtaa.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s2.explain: Labada tilmaan way is khilaafsan yihiin: shalay (waqti tegay) iyo 'will meet' (mustaqbal). Labada qaybood midkood waa sax keligiis, laakiin ma jiraan isla weedh.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.prompt: Saxi sadarka 5: '내일 도서관에 갔어요.' Ilaali weedha ku saabsan tagista maktabadda. Waxaad beddeli kartaa falka AMA erayga waqtiga. Qor weedhaha cusub.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore go'aami: ma rabtaa booqashada maktabadda inay noqoto mustaqbal mise waqti tegay?
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ilaali erayga waqtiga oo beddel dhammaadka, ama ilaali dhammaadka oo beddel erayga waqtiga.
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.hint.2: Waqti tegay: -았어요/-었어요. Mustaqbal: -ㄹ 거예요 (ama hadda fudud qorshe dhow).
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma erayga waqtigayga iyo dhammaadka falkaygu waxay tilmaamaan isla waqti?
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma weedhaygu weli wuxuu ka hadlayaa tagista maktabadda?
n-k-l1h-02.s.s3.modelNote.2: Hadda fudud sidoo kale waxaa loo isticmaalaa qorshe dhow.

n-k-l1h-03.title: Ma joogi kartaa bandhigga filimka saacadda hal?
n-k-l1h-03.goal: Go'aami xaqiiqooyinka usbuucaaga ee aad u baahan tahay ka hor intaadan jawaabin casumaadda saaxiib, ogow in laba xaqiiqo la isku daro, oo ku jawaab Kuuriyaan.
n-k-l1h-03.material:
Saaxiibkaa Jina ayaa kuu soo diraysa fariin.

지나: 토요일 한 시에 영화를 봐요. 같이 가요?

Waxaad eegaysaa usbuucaaga. Halkan waa waxa aad ogtahay:

- 토요일 수업이 오전 아홉 시에 시작해요.
- 토요일 수업이 열두 시에 끝나요.
- 학교에서 영화관까지 삼십 분 걸려요.
- 일요일 저녁에 가족 식사가 있어요.
- 월요일부터 금요일까지 회사에 가요.

n-k-l1h-03.thinking.1: Isku darka laba xaqiiqo (waqtiga dhammaadka + waqtiga safarka)
n-k-l1h-03.thinking.2: Iska indho tirka xaqiiqooyin run ah laakiin aan quseynin
n-k-l1h-03.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan maalmaha usbuuca iyo waqtiyada saacadda (열두 시, 한 시)
n-k-l1h-03.prereq.2: Wuxuu yaqaan 걸려요 (waqti ayay qaadataa); waxaa lagu sharaxay tilmaamaha
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.prompt: Waxaad rabtaa inaad ogaato haddii aad joogi karto bandhigga filimka saacadda hal Sabtida. Xaqiiqooyinkee ayaad u baahan tahay? Calaamadee xaqiiqo kasta oo aad u baahan tahay. (삼십 분 = 30 daqiiqo)
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qiyaas inaad dugsiga joogto marka fasalku dhammaado. Labadee shay ayaad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato si aad u tidhaahdo goorta aad imaanayso?
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.hint.1: Marka hore ka tir xaqiiqooyinka ku saabsan maalmaha kale.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.hint.2: Xaqiiqo kasta weydii: ma kuu sheegtaa goorta aan bannaan ahay, mise inta ay jidku qaadanayo?
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.r.a: Goorta fasalku bilaabmo ma beddelo goorta aad bannaan tahay. Raadi xaqiiqooyinka ku saabsan dhammaadka fasalka iyo jidka bandhigga filimka.
n-k-l1h-03.s.s1.r.d: Axaddu waa maalin kale. Ma saameeyo Sabtida saacadda hal.
